subject: Activation rally & owner orientation for Nimbus Health (Q4 go-live)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Saunders <emily.saunders@nimbus.health>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@nimbus.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Activation rally & owner orientation for Nimbus Health (Q4 go-live)

Emily / Rajiv —

Congrats again on the signed agreement — excited to get Nimbus into production. This thread is the internal/external activation rally: quick summary, owners, and immediate asks so we have a clean kickoff on Monday 10/25.

Deal highlights (short):
- Product: Redwood Hosted inference (text gen + embeddings), pinned model: rdlw-v1.3 (quantized).
- Committed capacity: Dedicated pool (4 GPUs), target steady-state throughput: ~25 reqs/s, burst 60 reqs/s.
- Go-live target: 2026-11-12 (customer acceptance window 11/12–11/19).
- Commercial: SOW attached (Nimbus_SOW_v2.pdf), Implementation_Timeline_Q4.xlsx attached.

Owners (primary):
- Customer Success (owner): Ben Carter — will lead onboarding, adoption, and change coordination.
- Implementation Lead: Karthik Iyer — infra, model pinning, staging validation, and cutover runbook.
- Sales success (me): Tessa Morgan — escalation and scope clarifications through acceptance.
- Delivery support: Marissa Cole — rollout QA and training materials.

Top risks / open items before kickoff:
1) SSO and IdP details (SAML metadata) — Emily, can you confirm if you will use Okta or Azure AD?
2) Data residency request — Nimbus asked for logs retention in us-east region; legal has approved but we need network egress confirmation.
3) Sample payloads and expected sequence lengths — we need representative files for perf testing.

Immediate asks (please before 10/24 EOD):
- Emily: share preferred kickoff window on 10/25–10/27 and SAML metadata; attach any FedRAMP/legal hold notes.
- Nimbus infra: provide 24-72 sample requests (anonymized) and peak token distribution.
- Ben/Karthik/Marissa: confirm internal intake steps and any capacity adjustments.

Ben — can you confirm you have capacity to start the staging validation week of 10/26 and whether you want a pre-kickoff sync with Karthik and Nimbus?

Thanks — I'll be on the kickoff to help with acceptance criteria.

—
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Activation rally & owner orientation for Nimbus Health (Q4 go-live)

Tessa — thanks for the clear summary and congrats to all.

Quick answers:
- Kickoff preference: 10/26 between 10:00–12:00 ET works best for our team (Emily, Rajiv, and our infra lead).
- SSO: We'll be using Okta; I’ll send SAML metadata and a point of contact (infra@ Nimbus) by EOD 10/21.
- Data residency: US-East is required; legal has signed off and will share the clause.
- Sample payloads: I can share a zipped set (anonymized) — attaching a placeholder link in my calendar invite.

A couple of additions from our side:
- We have an internal compliance checklist that needs a quick sign-off (I’ll attach later).
- We’d like Redwood to validate token usage under a 3x peak simulation — is that feasible during staging?

Looking forward to the kickoff on 10/26.

—
Emily Saunders
Head of Product Operations | Nimbus Health
emily.saunders@nimbus.health | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation rally & owner orientation for Nimbus Health (Q4 go-live)

Emily / team — great, 10/26 morning ET is on our side. I'll send a calendar invite with the kickoff agenda in a few minutes.

Initial staging plan (high level):
- Day 0 (pre-kickoff): ingest sample payloads, baseline perf tests (1x) against dedicated pool.
- Day 1 (staging validation): run 3x peak simulation (as requested) — collect latency percentiles and token cost delta.
- Day 2–3: acceptance tests, integration of SSO, and training walkthrough.

Karthik — please confirm you can run the 3x load test in the staging project and that you have the model variant rdlw-v1.3-quant configured for the dedicated pool. If we need an additional GPU for a short stress window we should budget for a burst instance (covered in the SOW).

Pre-kickoff checklist (Ben):
- Access: Nimbus to add ben.carter@redwood.com and karthik.iyer@redwood.com to their Okta test app.
- Files: sample payloads uploaded to the shared Drive folder.
- Legal: sign-off on the retention and logging clauses (Emily to attach).

I'll take point on the kickoff agenda and the acceptance criteria doc. Marissa — please prepare the initial enablement slides and the 30/60/90 adoption milestones.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0142

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 12:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation rally & owner orientation for Nimbus Health (Q4 go-live)

Ben / Emily — I can own the staging stress run. A few technical notes and asks before we start:

Technical notes:
- Model variant: rdlw-v1.3-quant has slightly different tokenization behavior vs the float variant; we should baseline both for acceptance.
- KV cache: for long sequences (>2k tokens) we'll need to enable the extended KV path in staging — I plan to toggle during the simulation.
- Monitoring: please ensure we have service tokens for tracing (I’ll provide the instrumentation snippet).

Pre-kickoff asks:
1) Provide a sample of the largest expected input (single-threaded) and an average-sized batch.
2) Confirm egress IP allowlist for our staging agents (I’ll send the IP range).
3) If Nimbus requires HIPAA-level logging controls, we need to confirm the exact retention window (we have retention templates in Credential_Matrix.csv).

I’ve attached a small credential matrix and a checklist (Credential_Matrix.csv). I’ll start the stress harness on 10/26 09:00 PT and share logs in the Drive folder.

—
Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead, Production Inference | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — confirming kickoff 10/26 10:30–11:30 ET (I sent the invite).

Attachments and confirmations:
- SAML metadata for our Okta app attached to the calendar invite.
- Compliance checklist — legal has signed the retention clause, see Drive link in invite.
- We uploaded sample payloads (largest ~3.6k tokens, average ~420 tokens) to the Drive folder.

Looking forward to the run on 10/26 — please call out any additional needs before Friday.
